reason: Automates DSH process lifecycle management by coordinating graceful restarts and shutdowns, resuming sessions, monitoring startup health, rolling back failed plugin changes, and refreshing connected pages.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供优雅重启、关闭、会话唤醒、启动故障回滚和页面自动刷新的生命周期自动化管理。
summaries.en: Automates DSH lifecycle management with graceful restarts and shutdowns, session resumption, startup-failure rollback, and connected-page refreshes.

capabilities: Wraps and launches DSH child processes
Schedules graceful restart and shutdown actions
Waits for active agent rounds to finish before restart
Automatically rolls back plugin dependency changes after startup failure
Captures startup stderr and records lifecycle state
Refreshes connected pages after process generation changes
